integrity: Two independent finite enumerators were run, source program outputs retained, and the proof is constructive. No external mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Labelled squares of cycles of order at least five only; the trace supplies an algorithmic complete enumerator, while simplified minimum-multiplicity formulas are given for residues 0, 1, 2, and 6. All finite program checks supplement an all-order mathematical proof. Earlier unindexed equivalent results may exist; no independent audit has occurred.
title: The total \([1,2]\)-domination polynomial of squared cycles and a constant-width optimum exclusion
